_comment: Screenshot manifest for the website and guide. kind=harness: 'shot' = ShotOpts for scripts/lib/harness.ts shot(); kind=copy: copies 'source'. Run `npm run site:shots -- --only id1,id2|--missing`, then `npm run site:build`.

shots.alt: A busy ski village in winter sunshine, lifts climbing the slopes behind the lodge.
shots.caption: Winter: lifts, pistes and a village that is getting busy.

shots.alt: The same valley in spring: blossom in the meadows, thin snow on the high slopes.
shots.caption: Spring: skiing up high, hiking down low.

shots.alt: A green summer valley with the village, hiking trails and meadows.
shots.caption: Summer: the snow is gone, the hikers and bikers arrive.

shots.alt: Autumn colours on the larger trees around the village.
shots.caption: Autumn: golden trees and a quiet breath before the snow.

shots.alt: The village at night with warm lit windows and lamp posts.
shots.caption: After dark the windows light up.

shots.alt: Skiers and snowboarders in colourful jackets streaming down a groomed slope.
shots.caption: Guests come in all shapes: skiers, boarders, families, hikers.

shots.alt: First-person view from a skier going down the slope, other guests ahead.
shots.caption: Ride along with any guest, from the lift to the bottom of the run.

shots.alt: Looking out from a chairlift seat over the valley and the cable.
shots.caption: Chairlift POV.

shots.alt: First-person walk in front of the base lodge.
shots.caption: Walk mode: stroll through your own resort.

shots.alt: Photo mode with a warm filter and a decorative frame around a dusk scene.
shots.caption: Photo mode: filters, frames and golden hour, saved locally as a PNG.

shots.alt: The main screen: top bar with money, rating and time; goals card on the right; the dock at the bottom.
shots.caption: The whole screen: top bar, goals card, dock.

shots.alt: The Buildings drawer open with category tabs and building cards with prices.
shots.caption: The Buildings drawer: tabs, prices and a season tag on each card.

shots.alt: The Lifts drawer showing the lift types, some locked in Career mode.
shots.caption: Lifts: eleven types, from T-bar to funicular.

shots.alt: The Pistes drawer with difficulty colours and grooming tools.
shots.caption: Paint pistes by colour; the game checks that they connect.

shots.alt: The Finance drawer with the money overview and tabs.
shots.caption: Finance: income, expenses, loans and reports.

shots.alt: The Pricing drawer with day pass and food price sliders.
shots.caption: Pricing: the game tells you if a price is cheap or expensive.

shots.alt: The Marketing drawer listing campaigns and their requirements.
shots.caption: Marketing campaigns and what each one needs.

shots.alt: The Operations drawer with staff and safety coverage.
shots.caption: Operations: staff, coverage and the safety picture.

shots.alt: The Career HUD: top bar, a level badge on the goals card and the dock along the bottom.
shots.caption: Career: the goals card carries your level badge; click it for the next level's requirements.

shots.alt: A level-up celebration banner over the resort.
shots.caption: Levelling up unlocks bigger lifts and buildings.

shots.alt: The scenario picker with six scenario cards and star difficulty.
shots.caption: Six scenarios, from a gentle valley to the Alpine Giant.

shots.alt: The New Game dialog with Career and Sandbox, map size and season.
shots.caption: New game: Career or Sandbox, map size, season, difficulty.

shots.alt: The Resort of the Year report with charts and awards.
shots.caption: Every in-game year ends with a report card (shown with demo numbers here).

shots.alt: The trophy shelf with achievements and cosmetic rewards.
shots.caption: The trophy shelf.

shots.alt: The settings dialog with sound, feedback intensity, text size and reduced motion.
shots.caption: Settings: sound, feedback, text size, reduced motion and more.

shots.alt: The settings dialog on a desktop screen, with sound, accessibility, touch controls and the privacy section.
shots.caption: Settings on desktop: sound, colour palette, touch controls and the privacy choice.

shots.alt: The help dialog listing keyboard shortcuts.
shots.caption: Press ? or H anywhere for the shortcut list.

shots.alt: The Save and Load dialog with slots and export buttons.
shots.caption: Save / Load: slots, quicksave and .slope export.

shots.alt: The pause menu with Resume, Save, Load, Settings, Help.
shots.caption: Esc opens the pause menu when nothing else is open.

shots.alt: The main menu with Continue, New game, Scenarios, Trophies and a live village behind it.
shots.caption: The title screen, with a live demo village behind the menu.

shots.alt: A brown bear on a meadow path with an orange threat overlay glowing around it, close to the village.
shots.caption: A bear in the woods. Rangers keep guests and bears apart.

shots.alt: A contact sheet of ten different generated resort towns.
shots.caption: Ten demo towns, all generated from a seed.

shots.alt: The village road decked out for the Christmas Market: bunting, a banner and striped market stalls beside the lift station.
shots.caption: Christmas Market: bunting, banner and stalls along the road.

shots.alt: A costumed carnival procession walking along a road hung with bunting, banners and flags.
shots.caption: Winter Carnival: banners, stalls and a costumed procession.

shots.alt: Decorated cows with flower headdresses walking down the village road for the Almabtrieb.
shots.caption: Almabtrieb: the decorated herd comes down in autumn.

shots.alt: The Marketing drawer with the Events calendar: festival cards with cost, length and requirements.
shots.caption: The Events calendar sits under the campaigns in the Marketing drawer.

shots.alt: The Staff tab of the Operations drawer: four crews, wage level and the six training courses.
shots.caption: Staff: four crews on Auto and six training courses.

shots.alt: The Landscape drawer on its Water tab: Dig pond and Fill in, with tabs for Terrain, Nature and Decor.
shots.caption: The Landscape drawer: Water, Terrain, Nature and Decor.

shots.alt: A pond dug on a level bench in summer, with a sand shore, boulders, a fountain, a fence, hedges and benches.
shots.caption: A pond with garden decor, all from the Landscape drawer.

shots.alt: The guest inspector for a named guest, Marta from Graz, with her wish, progress and Pin and Follow buttons.
shots.caption: A story guest: a name, one wish, and Pin and Follow buttons.

shots.alt: The rating panel open under the stars: bars for each part of the score including sustainability and a market line against nearby resorts.
shots.caption: The rating panel: one bar per facet, now with sustainability, and where you stand in the region.

shots.alt: The year report scrolled to The region: bars for each neighbouring resort and the Green Resort award among the awards.
shots.caption: The year report compares you with the neighbours and can award a Green Resort.

shots.alt: A slope profile card showing altitude over distance coloured by difficulty with a dashed snowline, next to a highlighted suggested run.
shots.caption: Slope profile and Suggest a run: see the gradient and the snowline before you build.

shots.alt: The Terrain drawer: a rail of cards for raise, lower, flatten, smooth and more with key badges and cost hints, and a side column with target, brush size, slope limit and a live cost preview.
shots.caption: The redesigned Terrain drawer: cards on the left, brush and cost on the right.

shots.alt: The View drawer with Camera, Modes, Overlays and Season groups of cards.
shots.caption: The View drawer: camera, modes, overlays and season.

shots.alt: The Statistics dialog with charts of guests, cash, rating and revenue over a chosen time range.
shots.caption: Statistics (I): guests, cash, rating and revenue over time.

shots.alt: The game on a phone held upright: compact top bar, goals, large on-screen speed buttons and a scrolling dock.
shots.caption: On a phone: a compact HUD with 44 px targets.

shots.alt: A phone showing the Buildings drawer open over the map.
shots.caption: Drawers on a phone slide up and tuck away.

shots.alt: A tablet in landscape with the Pistes drawer open and the touch controls on screen.
shots.caption: On a tablet the full layout fits, with bigger controls.

shots.alt: The slope-profile card for a suggested run drawn in the colour-blind-safe palette: sky blue, blue, vermillion and near-black for the four piste difficulties.
shots.caption: The colour-blind-safe palette on the slope profile (compare the green and blue of the default).

shots.alt: The Runs tab of the Operations drawer: a table of every run with level, length, drop, traffic, surface, grooming order and an Open / Closed button.
shots.caption: Operations > Runs: every run on its own row, with traffic, grooming order and an open / closed switch.

shot.evalJs: __slope.progression.setLevel(4);(()=>{const S=__slope.sim,L=S.lifts.all();const line=(a,b)=>{const n=Math.max(Math.abs(b.x-a.x),Math.abs(b.y-a.y),1);return Array.from({length:n+1},(_,i)=>({x:Math.round(a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n),y:Math.round(a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n)}))};const fat=(p)=>{const m=new Map();for(const t of p)for(const [dx,dy] of [[0,0],[1,0],[0,1],[1,1]])m.set((t.x+dx)+','+(t.y+dy),{x:t.x+dx,y:t.y+dy});return [...m.values()]};let tot=0;L.forEach((l,k)=>{const t=l.top,b=l.bottom,dx=b.x-t.x,dy=b.y-t.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len;(k==0?[[-4,1],[9,2]]:[[-4,3]]).forEach(([o,d],j)=>{const a={x:Math.round(t.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(t.y+1+ny*o)},c={x:Math.round(b.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(b.y+1+ny*o)};const pts=[...line({x:t.x+1,y:t.y+1},a),...line(a,c),...line(c,{x:b.x+1,y:b.y+1})];const r=S.networks.paint(1,fat(pts),d);tot+=r.painted});});console.log('RUNS painted',tot);const l0=L[0],c=__slope.renderer.controls,x=(l0.bottom.x+l0.top.x)/2,z=(l0.bottom.y+l0.top.y)/2;c.target.set(x,__slope.grid.getCorner(Math.round(x),Math.round(z))*0.5,z);})();setTimeout(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-recap').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),300);setInterval(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-toast').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),200)

shots.alt: The Runs map overlay: each run in its own colour with a name label, junction and station tiles in white.
shots.caption: The Runs overlay (O cycles overlays): every run in its own colour, labelled.

shot.evalJs: (()=>{const S=__slope.sim,L=S.lifts.all();const line=(a,b)=>{const n=Math.max(Math.abs(b.x-a.x),Math.abs(b.y-a.y),1);return Array.from({length:n+1},(_,i)=>({x:Math.round(a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n),y:Math.round(a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n)}))};const fat=(p)=>{const m=new Map();for(const t of p)for(const [dx,dy] of [[0,0],[1,0],[0,1],[1,1]])m.set((t.x+dx)+','+(t.y+dy),{x:t.x+dx,y:t.y+dy});return [...m.values()]};let tot=0;L.forEach((l,k)=>{const t=l.top,b=l.bottom,dx=b.x-t.x,dy=b.y-t.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len;(k==0?[[-4,1],[9,2]]:[[-4,3]]).forEach(([o,d],j)=>{const a={x:Math.round(t.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(t.y+1+ny*o)},c={x:Math.round(b.x+1+nx*o),y:Math.round(b.y+1+ny*o)};const pts=[...line({x:t.x+1,y:t.y+1},a),...line(a,c),...line(c,{x:b.x+1,y:b.y+1})];const r=S.networks.paint(1,fat(pts),d);tot+=r.painted});});console.log('RUNS painted',tot);const l0=L[0],c=__slope.renderer.controls,x=(l0.bottom.x+l0.top.x)/2,z=(l0.bottom.y+l0.top.y)/2;c.target.set(x,__slope.grid.getCorner(Math.round(x),Math.round(z))*0.5,z);})();__slope.setOverlay('runs');setTimeout(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-recap').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),300);setInterval(()=>document.querySelectorAll('st-toast').forEach(e=>{e.style.display='none'}),200)

shots.alt: The Maintenance tab of the Operations drawer: global Auto / Manual policy, a service window per lift, last and next service, overdue marks and a 30-day cost projection.
shots.caption: Operations > Maintenance: a service window for every lift.

shots.alt: The Energy tab of the Buildings drawer: Solar Array, Solar Plant, Wind Turbine, Small Hydro, Biomass Heating, Tree Nursery and Recycling & Compost Centre cards with prices.
shots.caption: Buildings > Energy: solar, wind, hydro, biomass, a nursery and a recycling centre.

shots.alt: A solar array and a wind turbine beside the village road in summer.
shots.caption: Solar panels and a wind turbine take a share of the lift energy bill.

shots.alt: The Operations drawer with the Snowmaking row: On, Off and Auto buttons, a status line and Turn all cannons off / on.
shots.caption: Operations > Snowmaking: On, Off or Auto, per resort and per cannon.

shots.alt: The loading splash: the Slope Tycoon icon and name above a slim progress bar with the text 'Waxing the fonts…'.
shots.caption: The loading splash shows real boot stages.
